hotel_name: Seven Seas Guest House - Adarsh Nagar, Delhi

positive_snippets:
I am staying with family . amazing, hotel worth to stay in-fact for families. I’m telling every Kashmiri to stay in case you visit Delhi / sophisticated staff . You can trust . Rest of the hotels near by are kind of OYO don’t choose them
Thank you.

Currently I’m here 16/01/2026

It is a small but good hotel , though on road but in a crowded  Adersh Nagar locality of Delhi. It is very close to Metro station.  I happened to stay over there for one night few months ago in connection with a marriage ceremony.  Fortunately,  I found a good mosque very close to it. Further, I noted that the hospitality as well as the cleanliness part was up to the mark.
negative_snippets:
Rooms are overpriced and rooms are not good. Staff behaviour is very rood.
Not a good option
Rooms not airy, no space for ventilation

I was caught in an unfortunate situation where I had to book a hotel offline and check in early morning. The guy charged me very high for a few hours (I checked out at 11 AM). The facilities are just OK and cleanliness is sub-par.
